title: The Slow Static
author: U. M. Thornbury
blurb: Ivo Iversen, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
